definitions.explanation: Having or appearing to have length, width, and depth. Used for physical objects, visual representations, and figurative descriptions of things with depth or complexity.

examples.japanese: {立体的|りったいてき}な⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧。
⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立体的|りったいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: Use makeup to make your face look more three-dimensional.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登場人物|とうじょうじんぶつ}→登場人物：16072_toujoujinbutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立体的|りったいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}かれていて→描く：02013_egaku⟧、{読|よ}みごたえ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The characters are depicted with depth, making it a rewarding novel to read.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{立体|りったい}→立体：18797_rittai⟧ (solid body, three-dimensional object) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix). Used both literally for physical three-dimensionality and figuratively for richness, depth, and complexity.

USAGE:
In everyday use, {立体的|りったいてき} frequently appears in beauty and fashion contexts (making features look more sculpted), art and design (creating depth), and literary criticism (well-developed characters or narratives).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立体的|りったいてき}な⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧ — three-dimensional structure
- {立体的|りったいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧ — to depict with depth
- {立体的|りったいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ — to make look three-dimensional
- {立体的|りったいてき}な⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧ — three-dimensional sound (surround sound)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {平面的|へいめんてき} — flat, two-dimensional; the antonym
- 3D（スリーディー） — 3D; used mainly for technology and entertainment
- ⟦{多面的|ためんてき}→多面的：19703_tamenteki⟧ — multifaceted; emphasizes having many aspects rather than physical depth
